Switch the model and the background switches with it, through the global switch effect y"},{"id":"p5s4","text":"ou choose on the Config page."},{"id":"p6s1","text":"> **v0.3.0 was a breaking release** — video wallpapers, generated backgrounds and the single global "},{"id":"p6s2","text":"theme color were removed. See the v0.3.0 entry in CHANGELOG.md."},{"id":"p7s1","text":"## How Model Rules Work"},{"id":"p8s1","text":"A rule is a **match string** plus **one complete set of background settings**. On a model switch the"},{"id":"p8s2","text":" plugin reads the current session's model name, scans the list top-down, and applies the **first** r"},{"id":"p8s3","text":"ule whose match string appears anywhere in it (case-insensitive) — with **rule 1** as the fallback w"},{"id":"p8s4","text":"hen nothing matches."},{"id":"p9s1","text":"Example list:"},{"id":"p10s1","text":"| # | Match string | Wallpaper |"},{"id":"p11s1","text":"| 1 | `deepseek` | Image A |
| 2 | `flash` | Image B |
| 3 | `glm` | Image C |"},{"id":"p12s1","text":"| Current model | Result | Why |"},{"id":"p13s1","text":"| `DeepSeek-Flash` | Rule 1 → Image A | `deepseek` matches first |
| `GLM-Flash` | Rule 2 → Image B "},{"id":"p13s2","text":"| `flash` is earlier in the list than `glm` |
| `Qwen-Flash` | Rule 2 → Image B | `flash` matches |
"},{"id":"p13s3","text":"| `GLM-Turbo` | Rule 3 → Image C | only `glm` matches |
| `Kimi-K3` | Fallback → Rule 1 → Image A | "},{"id":"p13s4","text":"ule 3 → Image C | only `glm` matches |
| `Kimi-K3` | Fallback → Rule 1 → Image A | no rule matches |"},{"id":"p14s1","text":"- **Order matters** — the first match wins, not the best match; drag rules to reorder them.
- **An e"},{"id":"p14s2","text":"mpty match string** makes a rule skip matching and act purely as a fallback, so a single rule with a"},{"id":"p14s3","text":"n empty match string is "one wallpaper everywhere".
- The match string is compared against **provide"},{"id":"p14s4","text":"r, model id and display name** concatenated, so any of the three can select a rule.
- The current mo"},{"id":"p14s5","text":"del is read from **this session's durable model selection** (the `modelSelection` projection the com"},{"id":"p14s6","text":"poser's own picker renders), so switching models inside a session takes effect immediately; the page"},{"id":"p14s7","text":" shows what was read, and marks it **host default** when only the host-wide default was available."},{"id":"p15s1","text":"> The example above has **no `kimi`** entry, so Kimi falls back to rule 1 = Image A and looks like ""},{"id":"p15s2","text":"nothing happened" — add a rule with the match string `kimi`."},{"id":"p16s1","text":"## Screenshots"},{"id":"p17s1","text":"One interface, one config — only the current model differs:"},{"id":"p18s1","text":"DeepSeek V4.1 Flash · matched the rule containing deepseek: a light wallpaper with a matching theme "},{"id":"p18s2","text":"eek V4.1 Flash · matched the rule containing deepseek: a light wallpaper with a matching theme color"},{"id":"p19s1","text":"Kimi K2.7 Code · matched the rule containing kimi: a dark wallpaper, and the whole interface reskinn"},{"id":"p19s2","text":"Code · matched the rule containing kimi: a dark wallpaper, and the whole interface reskinned with it"},{"id":"p20s1","text":"One rule on the Model Background tab · the layout mode, the framing, the theme color and the opacity"},{"id":"p20s2","text":"/brightness/blur all belong to the image being edited"},{"id":"p21s1","text":"Example wallpaper art from ZipZipPipe on bilibili"},{"id":"p22s1","text":"## Features"},{"id":"p23s1","text":"### Model rules"},{"id":"p24s1","text":"An ordered list of rules, matched first-hit against the current model's name, with rule 1 as the fal"},{"id":"p24s2","text":"ered list of rules, matched first-hit against the current model's name, with rule 1 as the fallback."},{"id":"p25s1","text":"- **Rules** — add, remove, reorder and name them; each carries its own match string, and a set of im"},{"id":"p25s2","text":"ages with their own look.
- **Images per rule** — a filmstrip filled by file picker, drag & drop or "},{"id":"p25s3","text":"a list of URLs; reorder it, promote one to first, or replace one in place (which keeps its position "},{"id":"p25s4","text":"in the rotation). A rule may also hold none, and an empty rule still matches while it has a theme co"},{"id":"p25s5","text":"lor of its own, so emptying one is a visible state rather than a trap.
- **Live match readout** — th"},{"id":"p25s6","text":"e Model Background tab shows which model was read and which rule it resolved to.
- **Import / export"},{"id":"p25s7","text":"** — the whole rule set as `dsh-background-by-model-theme.json` with every image inlined; files writ"},{"id":"p25s8","text":"ten by earlier releases still import.
- **On disk, not in `localStorage`** — everything lives under "},{"id":"p25s9","text":"`~/.dsh/.dsh-background-by-model-data/`, and old single-wallpaper configs migrate in place on first "},{"id":"p25s10","text":"read.
- **Bilingual**, with automatic locale detection, plus a theme watchdog that re-asserts the th"},{"id":"p25s11","text":"eme if the host resets it."},{"id":"p26s1","text":"### Image rotation"},{"id":"p27s1","text":"Per rule, and **off by default** — cycling spends real bandwidth, memory and battery, so nothing tur"},{"id":"p27s2","text":"ff by default** — cycling spends real bandwidth, memory and battery, so nothing turns it on for you."},{"id":"p28s1","text":"- **Dwell time** — 10 s / 30 s / 1 min / 5 min / 30 min, or any custom value in seconds (5 s – 24 h)"},{"id":"p28s2","text":".
- **Order** — **In order** walks the list and wraps around; **Shuffle** picks among every image ex"},{"id":"p28s3","text":"cept the one on screen, so a tick never looks like it was missed.
- **Also step on a model switch** "},{"id":"p28s4","text":"— a second trigger that runs no timer at all.
- **Next image** — steps the wallpaper on demand, whet"},{"id":"p28s5","text":"her or not the timer is running.
- **Only the active rule rotates**, on one timer for the whole plug"},{"id":"p28s6","text":"in; a hidden tab stops the rotation with the pixels."},{"id":"p29s1","text":"### Switch effect (global)"},{"id":"p30s1","text":"What a wallpaper **change** looks like — one setting on the Config page, shared by every rule, cover"},{"id":"p30s2","text":"ing a model switch, a rotation step, **Next image** and a holiday taking over."},{"id":"p31s1","text":"- **Four effects** — **Cross-fade** (the default), **Instant**, **Zoom in** and **Slide in**; zoom a"},{"id":"p31s2","text":"nd slide only animate `transform` on the incoming layer, so neither costs a byte of extra transfer.
"},{"id":"p31s3","text":"- **Easing and one duration** — standard / linear / ease-out / ease-in-out, and `0`–`3000 ms` where "},{"id":"p31s4","text":"`0` is a hard cut rather than "unset". It replaced the per-rule `rotate.fadeMs`, which had no contro"},{"id":"p31s5","text":"l anywhere; a hand-tuned value is folded into it on first read.
- **Reduced motion is a veto**, not "},{"id":"p31s6","text":"a shorter animation.
- **The interface color fades on the same clock** — except a light↔dark flip, w"},{"id":"p31s7","text":"hich switches instantly, because interpolating between two palettes walks through mid-tones whose te"},{"id":"p31s8","text":"xt is unreadable in both directions.
- **A preview swatch** replays the effect, because a wallpaper "},{"id":"p31s9","text":"fading into itself is invisible."},{"id":"p32s1","text":"### Holiday backgrounds"},{"id":"p33s1","text":"One switch on the Config page and nothing else: on 中秋节 and 国庆节 the wallpaper switches to that holida"},{"id":"p33s2","text":"y's own art and theme color, and back the next morning. It ships **off**, and the recommended profil"},{"id":"p33s3","text":"d theme color, and back the next morning. It ships **off**, and the recommended profile turns it on."},{"id":"p34s1","text":"[该节后续省略]"}],"truncated":true}
